en: A vintage black‑and‑white (hand‑colored) postcard showing a large, two‑story school building with a central domed structure on the roof, trees and a dirt street with utility poles in front. The image is bordered by a white margin containing printed red text, including a caption at the bottom identifying the scene as a high school in Pasadena, California, and side text indicating the publisher and that it was printed in Germany.
